messages.subject: Shiny without Bootstrap
parts:
Good day,

I like Shiny very much, but Bootstrap does not fit my needs. Most of the widgets are huge and take tremendous amount of place, so if I want to make an application that looks more or less as desktop app with a lot of widgets Bootstrap does not seem as good choice. I would like to use some alternatives e.g. http://photonkit.com. Does anyone has experience with this kind of things? Shall I just recreate all widgets or there is an easier way to do this? Will be very grateful for any advices!

With best wishes,
Sergey
